title: Tokyo 2020 Olympic Distance Running
description: Middle-distance drama at a recent Summer Games—five races, five revelations.

questions.question: Which Kenyan with 44-second 400m speed won men's 800m gold at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics?
questions.explanation: He jogged the first lap in 54 seconds, then powered past Australia's Peter Bol off the final bend for Kenya's fourth straight Olympic 800m title—with a teammate right on his heels.

questions.question: Korir led a Kenyan one-two in that final—which teammate took silver?
questions.explanation: The event's first same-nation 1-2 since 1992. Bronze went to Poland's Patryk Dobek, a 400m hurdler who had only started racing the 800m that year.

questions.question: While Korir and Rotich went one-two for the men, who won the women's 800m gold at the same Tokyo Games?
questions.explanation: Mu, 19, led wire to wire in an American-record 1:55.21—the first U.S. women's 800m gold since Madeline Manning in 1968. The teenager chasing her set a national record too.

questions.question: Who finished second behind Athing Mu in that 800m final?
questions.explanation: Also 19, she kicked from fourth to second in 1:55.88, wiping out a British record that had stood since 1995—set by a runner who later made Olympic history of her own.

questions.question: Keely Hodgkinson's Tokyo run erased the British 800m record set in 1995 by which future double Olympic champion?
questions.explanation: Holmes's 1:56.21 had stood 26 years. The twist: with Mu out after falling at the 2024 U.S. trials, Hodgkinson won Paris gold—Britain's first in the event since Holmes in 2004.
